name: Ujung Kulon National Park
description: Ujung Kulon National Park occupies the far south-western tip of Java, Indonesia, taking in a forested peninsula, the Gunung Honje mountains and several offshore islands. It shelters the biggest surviving stretch of lowland rainforest on Java. This is also one of the last refuges of the critically endangered Javan rhinoceros, among many other threatened plants and animals.
